edition_title: Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — July 2026 Edition
edition_intro: You are not waiting for the world to hand you a seat — you are building one. This July 2026 edition compiles 14 rigorously verified, currently open opportunities across scholarships, grants, conferences, competitions, and certifications — curated specifically for ambitious young Nigerians and Africans who move fast and build things that last. Read it, pick your lane, and apply before the window closes.

posts.title: Schwarzman Scholars Program 2027–2028 (Fully Funded Master's at Tsinghua University, China)
posts.summary: A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at one of China's top universities, designed to build the next generation of global leaders — and it is open to Nigerians right now.
posts.eligibility: Ages 18–28 with a completed or in-progress undergraduate degree; open to all nationalities worldwide including Nigerians

posts.title: GREAT Scholarships 2026–27 for Nigerian Students (UK Government & British Council)
posts.summary: Up to £10,000 toward tuition fees at leading UK universities for a one-year postgraduate course, exclusively for students from Nigeria — with multiple institutions still accepting applications.
posts.deadline: Rolling (varies by institution — check individual university pages)
posts.eligibility: Nigerian nationals applying for a one-year, full-time taught postgraduate programme at a participating UK university in 2026–27

posts.title: ALX Africa — Mastercard Foundation Sponsored Programmes (Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Cloud Computing)
posts.summary: Fully sponsored tech training programmes for young Nigerians and Africans, covering Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, and Data Analytics, with programme costs waived for eligible candidates through the Mastercard Foundation partnership.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans aged 18–30 in Nigeria who meet programme-specific eligibility criteria; sponsored places prioritise those who cannot afford fees

posts.title: All On Off-Grid Energy Challenge 2026 (Up to $1,000,000 in Blended Funding)
posts.summary: Nigeria's largest off-grid energy funding competition, offering between $200,000 and $1 million in blended grants and investment to Nigerian clean energy startups — closing July 31.
posts.eligibility: Majority Nigerian-owned, for-profit companies legally registered and operating in Nigeria with an innovative, commercially viable off-grid energy solution

posts.title: MEST AI Startup Program — Class of 2027 (Fully Sponsored, Up to $100,000 Pre-Seed Investment)
posts.summary: A fully sponsored 12-month residential AI startup programme in Accra, Ghana — open to Nigerian developers aged 21–35 — where top ventures pitch for up to $100,000 in pre-seed funding.
posts.eligibility: Ages 21–35 with software development experience and interest in entrepreneurship; citizens of Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, or Kenya

posts.title: Accelerate Africa Startup Programme 2026 (Up to $500,000 Investment for Early-Stage African Founders)
posts.summary: A structured accelerator programme offering early-stage African founders expert-led guidance, access to the Future Africa fund, and potential investment of up to $500,000.
posts.eligibility: Early-stage African founders building globally impactful businesses; open to all African nationalities including Nigerians

posts.title: UNDP African Youth Co-Creators Council 2026
posts.summary: UNDP is selecting 11 young African leaders from across the continent and diaspora to serve on an advisory council shaping UNDP's Africa agenda — with fully covered participation.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans and diaspora youth with demonstrated leadership experience in development, tech, or social innovation; ages typically 18–35

posts.title: Africa-Europe Youth Academy (AEYA) New Leaders Lab 2026
posts.summary: A fully funded leadership programme for young people aged 18–30 across 19 African countries, combining entrepreneurial training, mentorship, and high-level policy engagement between Africa and Europe.
posts.eligibility: Ages 18–30, nationals of one of 19 eligible African countries including Nigeria, with demonstrated leadership or entrepreneurial activity

posts.title: RAEng Africa Prize for Engineering Innovation 2027 (Up to £50,000 Prize)
posts.summary: Africa's largest engineering innovation prize — £50,000 for the winner, plus an 8-month mentorship and commercialisation programme — now open for Nigerian engineers and innovators.
posts.eligibility: Citizens of sub-Saharan African countries (including Nigeria) with a scalable engineering innovation at early commercialisation stage; individuals or teams welcome

posts.title: Oxford Saïd Global Climate Tech Challenge 2026 (Fully Funded Trip to Oxford + Scholarship Prize)
posts.summary: High school students (ages 15–18) worldwide can enter a climate technology competition judged by Oxford University academics, with finalists winning fully funded trips to Oxford and the winning team earning a full scholarship to a 2027 Oxford summer school.
posts.eligibility: High school students aged 15–18 applying in teams of 3–5 from any country worldwide; no application fee

posts.title: Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 (₦200 Million Prize Pool)
posts.summary: Wema Bank's flagship annual hackathon challenges Nigerian tech teams to build MVPs solving real structural problems, with ₦200 million in cumulative prizes, API access, and direct investor connections.
posts.deadline: Rolling — apply now via the Hackaholics portal
posts.eligibility: Software developers, UI/UX designers, and tech innovators based in Nigeria; teams of up to 3 members; no registration fee

posts.title: AWS AI Upskilling Campaign 2026 — 50% Off AI Practitioner + Free Cloud Practitioner
posts.summary: AWS is offering 50% off the AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam via promo code AIF2CLOUD, and anyone who passes automatically receives a free AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) voucher — valid through September 30, 2026.
posts.eligibility: Anyone aged 18 and above worldwide; no technical background required for the AI Practitioner exam; exams taken through Pearson VUE

posts.title: Microsoft Virtual Training Days — Free & 50%-Off Azure, AI & Security Exam Vouchers
posts.summary: Microsoft runs free, live, instructor-led online training events globally throughout 2026, and every attendee who completes a qualifying session receives a 50% discount exam voucher for a Microsoft Fundamentals certification (AZ-900, AI-900, SC-900, DP-900, and others).
posts.deadline: Rolling — new events added monthly at events.microsoft.com
posts.eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with a free Microsoft account; no prior technical experience required for Fundamentals-level sessions

posts.title: Google Cloud Skills Boost — Free Monthly Learning Credits & Certification Pathways (2026)
posts.summary: Google Cloud's Skills Boost platform provides free monthly credits through its No-Cost Labs programme and periodic Google Cloud Innovators programmes, enabling Nigerians to earn Google Cloud certifications at reduced or zero cost.
posts.eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with a free Google account; specific free-credit programmes may have regional or cohort-based eligibility
